Your account is ready

1. Install the CLI
   curl -fsSL https://repose.herakraft.co/install.sh | sh

2. Run it in a project
   repose run

3. Choose a plan on the dashboard

Choose a plan: https://repose.herakraft.co/billing

Seven days are free on any plan, with a card at checkout. The first charge is on day eight unless you cancel before then.

The docs: https://repose.herakraft.co/docs

--
repose. Open the dashboard: https://repose.herakraft.co
